title: MMAI Lab at CoRL 2026
description: Students Junhyeong Go and Mingyu Jung of the MMAI Lab presented their paper "FlowVLA: Enabling World Dynamics Understanding through Pluggable 3D Flow Learning" at CoRL 2026 (Conference on Robot Learning) in Austin, Texas, and met Professor Gi-Cheon Kang at the poster session.

photos.alt: Junhyeong Go and Mingyu Jung Standing by Their FlowVLA Poster
photos.caption: From left: Junhyeong Go (student) and Mingyu Jung (student) with the poster "FlowVLA: Enabling World Dynamics Understanding through Pluggable 3D Flow Learning," co-authored with Woobin Im (Samsung Electronics) and Professor Jongbin Ryu.

photos.alt: Gi-Cheon Kang, Junhyeong Go, and Mingyu Jung in Front of the FlowVLA Poster
photos.caption: From left: Gi-Cheon Kang (professor), Junhyeong Go (student), and Mingyu Jung (student) at the FlowVLA poster.
